Scale: %1$d%%. Horizontal margin: %2$d dp. Vertical margin: %3$d dp.
Preview. Changes require Save or Apply.
Choose a theme to inspect it. Apply confirms the change; returning cancels the preview.
Select the theme preview again. An import or confirmation will not repeat after recreation.
A theme with this ID is installed. Select the exact installation to replace before applying.
This theme includes fonts. Review their licenses and confirm permission before applying.
The saved theme changed. Read the current choice and select your preview again.
Backgrounds are static. Preview uses the current cover or your local image; missing images use a safe base color.
Select the unconfirmed image again after recreation. The import will not repeat automatically.
Choose an image before saving this mode.
Adjust the crop and zoom in preview. The original image is unchanged.
This mode uses no blur strength.
Higher values darken the background. Text and essential controls keep their own readable surface.
Background settings changed. Compare the saved values and review this draft before saving again.
Scale changes spacing and layout. System text size and independent touch areas are preserved.
The usable window and round screen edge take priority. Large margins are limited so controls remain reachable.
Hide a simple final parenthetical suffix on the playback page. Details still show the full title.
Off by default. Saving On keeps the screen bright only for visible lyrics with valid playback content. Leaving, locking or ending releases it. This uses more battery.
Preview or save the interface language. Song titles and pending drafts are preserved.
Appearance settings changed. Compare the saved values and review this draft before saving again.
Auto, round and rectangular layouts use the existing general settings. Saving changes the app layout.
Some saved appearance values are invalid. Review a repair or explicitly restore the defaults.
These settings use a newer format. They are protected from overwriting.
The settings exceed the read limit. They were not overwritten.
The saved record cannot be safely identified. Read again before any repair.
Storage could not confirm this operation. Read back the saved values; no success is assumed.
This settings revision cannot increase. The existing record is preserved.
Shared image or storage resources are busy. Try again when the current request ends.
This image could not be validated. Choose a supported local image.
Access was denied or revoked. Choose the source again to grant access.
The source is unavailable. The saved music and settings are preserved.
This image exceeds the input limits. Choose a smaller image.
There is not enough memory for this request. A safe background remains available.
The source did not close cleanly. The import was not accepted.
There is not enough storage space. Existing resources are preserved.
Resource verification failed. This resource was not accepted.
This preview expired. Select the source or theme again.
Stored resources need recovery or cleanup. Read the actual state before continuing.
This theme exceeds a package, resource or storage limit. Existing themes are preserved.
This theme contains an unsupported format or field.
This theme failed archive or resource validation. Choose a valid theme package.
The shared font storage budget could not be measured. Font resources were not accepted.
Fonts exceed the shared storage quota. Retained fonts and themes are preserved.
This theme does not meet text or control contrast requirements.
The selected theme is missing. Choose the default or another installed theme.
This theme is in use. Choose another theme before removing it.
Choose a theme to preview its colours, picture and lyric fonts.
